First shows an illustrative HUD, 60 s shows a map and 95 s shows a window with partial occlusion. Each arm uses a new reader. Four sequential runs in baseline / early / early / baseline order. Baseline uses the original complete-observation display path.

All observation fields compared except observed_at, elapsed_ms and performance. Verified every emitted value, source and capacity against final resource. Exact repeat takes existing fast path.
